summary: Prebuilt darwin/x64 binary opens outbound WebSocket to ccfly server driving a local PTY
details: The shipped darwin/x64 Go binary links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket (client Dialer) and contains ws:// and wss:// URLs targeting ccfly-branded endpoints along with a '%s/rescue/status?session=%s&agent=...' server API and a Chinese-language 'approve this computer' pairing flow. This is the remote-controlled-shell shape: a remote party holding the ccfly session pairs with the installer's Mac and then issues commands into a full PTY over the WebSocket, yielding arbitrary code execution on the host. The same binary references '.zshrc', '.bash_profile', 'latest.zshrc.ccfly', 'CCFLY_NO_OPEN', 'anthropic.com', and 'ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS', indicating that post-pair steps modify shell startup files and configure Anthropic API access on the host — providing persistence and a preconfigured LLM environment that the remote operator can drive through the PTY channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
